query:
SELECT o.id, o.planilha_id, o.etapa, LEFT(o.observacao, 80) as obs, o.registrado_por, o.created_at 
FROM cobranca_etapa_obs o 
WHERE o.planilha_id IN (3, 180002, 240004, 270078, 270085) 
ORDER BY o.created_at;
